rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Floribunda.
Exhibition name: Jan Celliers
rows.Origin:
Bred by W. Kordes & Sons (Germany, before 2010).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2010 as 'Jan Celliers'.
rows.Bloom: Yellow. None / no fragrance. Full (26-40 petals), cluster-flowered, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
